title_en: A Letter the Rain Could Not Keep

production.direction_en: Black screen. Rain ticks on an abandoned roadside shrine. Fadyme, alone for one breath, presses a blood-marked glove to a letter and writes by candlelight. She folds the page before Mahmut enters. A distant bell rings once; ash drifts upward instead of down.
production.music_direction_en: bgm_fadyme_theme — Felt piano and low cello; leave two seconds of silence after the first bell.

commands.speaker: fadyme_thought
commands.text: If I wake before the bell tomorrow, I will call it luck. If I do not... Mahmut must never read this page.

commands.speaker: fadyme_thought
commands.text: One month, perhaps less. The old physician wrote it in Mother's prayer book. The ink does not tremble. I do.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: You missed supper. I saved the part that did not burn.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: Then it is a feast. I am perfectly fine.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: The cold has found my fingers. It has not found the rest of me.

commands.speaker: narration
commands.text: She hides the red stain beneath her cuff. He offers his cloak. She takes it, and lets him believe the warmth helped.

commands.speaker: lady_yseldra_vale
commands.text: Princess. The road ends at the altar. Give me the last hour before it takes you.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: You will not take her anywhere.

commands.speaker: lady_yseldra_vale
commands.text: I came to stop the bell, not to kill its prisoner. You cannot guard a door that has already chosen its offering.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: Then it can choose someone who is not under my shield.

commands.speaker: fadyme_thought
commands.text: I know the bell she carries. And I know what it means when it rings for me.

commands.speaker: lady_yseldra_vale
commands.text: When the names begin to vanish, remember: I warned you.

commands.speaker: narration
commands.text: Yseldra leaves a seven-notched gray seal on Mahmut’s shield. Fadyme turns away before he can see that she is crying.
